描述_EN: on 14 february 2013 the telegraph newspaper published allegations made by a former employee at a tesco distribution centre in ireland. on 8 february 2013, the financial times ran an article on working conditions at the eight amazon warehouses located across the uk. the motorola wt41n0 is a labour-saving device used by tesco, shoe zone and other retailers. wearable technologies in the workplace hit headlines in february 2013 when newspapers revealed that the performance of warehouse workers was being monitored using data from devices like this one. wearing the device on the wrist or at the hip, the worker uses a finger-mounted scanner or voice-control headset to record activity. if an error is made they receive immediate feedback. he claimed that data collected from wrist-worn devices was being used to grade staff performance, with those not meeting expectations being called before the boss. it is designed to increase accuracy and efficiency in warehouses. devices such as the wt41n0 make possible a new type of work where the organisation of goods and deployment of staff is entrusted to a computerised system. connected to a network, the windows-based microcomputer distributes tasks and tracks their completion. employees interviewed at the rugeley site complained of the blisters developed as they strove to fulfil tasks allocated via handheld computers. this story was the second in a week in the national press to draw attention to wearable computing devices and their impact on the work environment. weighing less than 400g, it is ergonomically designed for prolonged use.
描述_ZN: 2013年2月14日，《电讯报》刊登了爱尔兰特易购配送中心的一名前雇员的指控。 2013年2月8日，《金融时报》刊登了一篇关于亚马逊在英国的八个仓库的工作条件的文章。 motorola wt41n0是一种节省劳动力的设备，被乐购、鞋区和其他零售商使用。 工作场所的可穿戴技术在2013年2月成为头条新闻，当时报纸披露，仓库工人的表现正通过像这样的设备的数据被监控。 将设备戴在手腕上或臀部，工人使用一个安装在手指上的扫描仪或语音控制耳机来记录活动。 如果出现错误，他们会立即收到反馈。 他声称，从腕戴式设备中收集的数据被用来给员工的表现打分，那些没有达到预期的员工被叫到老板面前。 它被设计用来提高仓库的准确性和效率。 像wt41n0这样的设备使一种新型的工作成为可能，在这种工作中，货物的组织和工作人员的部署都委托给了一个计算机化系统。 与网络连接，基于windows的微电脑分配任务并跟踪其完成情况。 在Rugeley基地接受采访的员工抱怨说，当他们努力完成通过手持电脑分配的任务时，会出现水泡。 这篇报道是一周内国家媒体上的第二篇报道，引起了对可穿戴计算设备及其对工作环境影响的关注。 重量小于400克，符合人体工程学设计，适合长时间使用。
